data.narrative:
Modern Intelligence, a seed-stage defense and security company founded by John Dulin, Joe Cieslik, and Tristan Tager, has raised $5.12M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 peers—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—spanning seed and Series A stages within the Defense & Security sector.

Two valuation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression method uses the $5.12M raised as a proxy base and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $12.8M. The Peer-Median method examines the 4-company peer sample across same-sector and adjacent-stage positioning. That sample—comprising Stark Defence ($4.0B, Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A)—produces a median valuation of $700M, with a range of $125M to $4.0B.

Triangulation of the two methods generates a low-end estimate of $10.9M, a median of $356M, and a high-end estimate of $805M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty regarding Modern Intelligence's relative positioning within the peer set and the stage-appropriate multiple. Near-term catalysts—funding stage progression, customer traction, and comparative technical capability—will be critical to narrowing this range.
